# IS Inventory

> IS Inventory is all-in-one, web-based management software (SaaS) for any membership-based studio or club — gyms and fitness studios, swim schools, yoga & Pilates studios, martial arts academies, and dance studios — including multi-site franchise groups. It covers memberships, class scheduling, online bookings, online payments and POS, QR-code access control, and real-time analytics — in one dashboard that works on any device with no app installation. Each industry has its own tailored landing page on a dedicated subdomain, but the underlying platform is identical. IS Inventory is a product of UBQ Solutions FZ-LLC, based in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, serving customers internationally. Start free with a 1-month trial (no credit card required) or book a personalized demo.

## Features

- **Membership management** (https://www.gymflyte.com/membership-management): registration to renewals, freezing, transfers, member records and packages, automated check-ins.
- **Analytics** (https://www.gymflyte.com/analytics): real-time revenue, membership KPIs, and multi-branch performance dashboards for faster business decisions.
- **Scheduling** (https://www.gymflyte.com/scheduling): create and manage class sessions and trainer schedules with customizable access, real-time updates, and full calendar control.
- **Booking** (https://www.gymflyte.com/booking): members book classes in seconds; reduces no-shows and admin work.
- **Access control** (https://www.gymflyte.com/access-control): QR-code check-ins with membership-based permissions, fast secure entry, and detailed access reports.
- **Online payments** (https://www.gymflyte.com/online-payments): accepts Apple Pay, Mada, STC Pay, Tabby, and more; recurring payments and smart invoicing.

## Key facts

- Multi-branch: manage several locations, staff, and trainers from one account with corporate-level reports.
- Mobile friendly: fully responsive web app — no installation, works on phones and tablets, real-time sync across devices.
- Bilingual member-facing support (Arabic/English); the website itself is available in English, Arabic, German, French, Dutch, and Japanese.
- Data import and quick onboarding; typical go-live within one business day.
- **Member portal** (customer-facing, included): members get their own login to manage their profile, view a QR entry pass, see and pay their bills, manage saved cards, and browse a gym directory to join. They can book classes from a live calendar — including drop-in bookings that need NO membership, paid online or settled at the gym — and one account can belong to several gyms at once. If online payments are on, a booking is charged and marked paid instantly; otherwise it's booked and settled by staff.

## Pricing

Base prices in USD; the pricing page automatically shows local-currency equivalents. Every plan includes the same core feature set — the only base-price difference is the commitment length. Optional paid addons (POS & Inventory, Advanced Reports) can be added or removed at any time for a monthly fee on top of the plan.

- Monthly: $99/month (regular $125)
- 6 months: $549 (regular $785)
- Yearly: $999 (regular $1,650)

Every new gym gets a 1-month free trial with every module unlocked — no credit card required. Self-service signup: https://www.gymflyte.com/get-started

Details: https://www.gymflyte.com/pricing
